scope: Read-only audit of all 63 batch-4 rows against input frontmatter and existing work bodies, emphasizing the 33 verified-purchase rows and edition or ordering caveats. Targeted live verification supports the corrections below. This is not a new exhaustive availability search.

proposed_corrections.name: Camille Saint-Saens - The Swan

proposed_fields.evidence: Nobuya Sugawa arrangement, ZN560112 / HL50490805, for soprano (tenor) or alto (baritone) saxophone and piano. Publisher lists a price and Add to Cart.
proposed_fields.notes: Special import item. Publisher says US stock may be unavailable and the item can be ordered on request through a retailer; price and additional shipping charges may vary.

proposed_corrections.rationale: The existing evidence unnecessarily leaves saxophone voices unresolved. The opened publisher page identifies all four voices and an ordering caveat.
proposed_corrections.verification_method: Opened publisher page in web reader, product description and import-order notice.

proposed_corrections.name: Dietrich Erdmann - Konzert

proposed_fields.notes: This is the composer piano reduction. The concerto requires one soloist doubling soprano and alto saxophones; the catalog alto-only field is incomplete. Orchestral performance materials are outside this purchase.

proposed_corrections.rationale: The work body documents the soprano/alto doubling and reduction. Preserve that practical distinction in the combined manifest.
proposed_corrections.verification_method: Compared catalog work body and frontmatter with report; opened publisher orchestra catalog. Retailer ordering was already browser-confirmed in batch 4.

proposed_corrections.verification_method: Current direct HTTP retrieved the product description, in-stock statement and Add to cart.

proposed_corrections.name: Paul R. Goldstaub - Graphics IV

proposed_fields.notes: The Dorn catalog lists DP168 Graphics IV under alto saxophone and piano on printed page 5. It separately lists DP502 Graphic IV for alto saxophone and celeste on printed page 29. The linked June Emerson DP0168 product matches the piano edition. Do not substitute the celeste listing or treat it as disproving the piano edition.

proposed_corrections.rationale: The private catalog notes refer to DP502. The current publisher catalog contains both entries, so downgrading the verified piano purchase on that basis would over-infer a mismatch.
proposed_corrections.verification_method: Opened Dorn catalog in web reader; both Goldstaub entries found at PDF pages 5 and 29.

proposed_corrections.name: Philippe Leroux - SPP

proposed_fields.notes: Billaudot places this product in its E-flat saxophone category. The composer website identifies SPP for soprano saxophone and piano, and Music Eight offers the Billaudot work for B-flat soprano and piano. Preserve those sources for the voice identification.

proposed_corrections.rationale: The report invokes IRCAM for soprano identification without supplying its URL. Opened composer and retailer sources provide traceable soprano evidence while retaining the publisher-category discrepancy.
proposed_corrections.verification_method: Opened composer recordings page and retailer product page in web reader. Publisher page category also opened.
